name: Frigorific-Col
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near an orbital debris ring.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on dark crystals, nitrogen, helium-3 and carbon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
